name: Grade 7 Mathematics Term 1 Lesson Notes
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to identify place value up to 9999
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to read and write numbers in words
learningActivities: Mental maths warm-up: teacher calls out numbers, learners state place value of underlined digit
Board work: teacher writes 4-digit number, learners identify place value of each digit in pairs
Worksheet exercise: identify place value of underlined digits in various numbers
Class discussion: why is place value important in everyday life?
keyPoints: Place value determines the value of a digit based on its position
In the number 5,432: 5 is in thousands place, 4 is in hundreds place, 3 is in tens place, 2 is in ones place
Moving one place to the left multiplies by 10; moving one place to the right divides by 10
commonMisconceptions: Thinking the digit itself determines value, not its position
Confusing tens and ones place when writing numbers in words
lessonEvaluation: Learners complete a short exercise identifying place value of digits in 4-digit numbers. Teacher marks and provides feedback.
teacherReflection: Most learners understood place value concept. Need more practice for those who confused tens and ones.
